item.title: Pigeonhole 1.7.2
item.description: • Safer with Shunt: Pigeonhole only moves tabs from the exact window you're in. Before, a tab moved from an incognito window could take a tab from an ordinary window instead. Incognito tabs now move the browser's own way (turn on Allow in Incognito for Pigeonhole if you want them to join windows too).
